documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for To Consider, Inter Alia, Matters Relating To Call Money On Partly Paid Equity Shares Issued Under The Rights Issue And Other Related And Incidental Matters.
Intimation Of Book Closure - Pursuant To Regulation 42 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
Intimation Of 34Th Annual General Meeting To Be Held On Tuesday, September 29, 2026 And Book Closure.

analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 along with the notice for its 34th Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 29, 2026. The document outlines ordinary and special businesses, including the re-appointment of directors and procedural details for electronic voting and video conferencing. Management noted that no dividend was declared for the year 2015-16, thereby avoiding IEPF transfer requirements. The report also provides detailed profiles and justifications for directors seeking appointment or re-appointment. Management reports that fiscal year 2024-25 focused on empowering small and microbusinesses through accessible artificial intelligence (AI) platforms such as dSpeedUp, dRyZe CRM, dBotMinds, and Zaywoo.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered.
demand_outlook.quote: An additional 9% plan to begin using AI within the next year, indicating that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to small business needs.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to small business needs, introduced affordable pricing models, and provided training and support to lower barriers to adoption.

orders_capacity.claim: dSpeedUp's digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not declare any dividend for the year 2015-16.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company has not declared any dividend for the year 2015-16, the transfer of the amount of dividend that remains unclaimed for a period of 7 years to the IEPF account and the shares on which dividends remain unpaid or unclaimed for a period of seven consecutive years or more to the Demat account of IEPF Authority does not arise;

risks_headwinds.claim: Many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: Calsoft remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
